subject: GCP hourly-sample provenance: missing samples affecting VAT allocations
messages:
From: Acme Billing <acme.billing@acme.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: gcp-marketplace-ops@gcp-marketplace.com
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Discrepancy: missing hourly samples impacting Sept payouts (Acme Co)

Jonas,

We reviewed our Sept payout and noticed a ~12% shortfall vs the usage we see in our internal telemetry. Our engineer traced this to gaps in the hourly sample files from GCP marketplace (several hourly windows for sku: REDWOOD-CHAT-XL are absent). That missing granularity is pushing the VAT classification into the wrong ledger and is creating a withholding.

Can Redwood provide:
- the raw hourly samples you received from GCP for 2026-09-01 -> 2026-09-14 (CSV or checksum)
- any reconciliations you ran that would explain dropped hours (ingest errors, TTL, backfills)
- confirmation if this will affect the upcoming payout (and if so an ETA on correction)

I've attached a short CSV extract that highlights three missing hours (rows 02:00-04:00 on 2026-09-04).

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Billing Ops / Acme Co
---
Attachment: excerpt_gcp_hours.csv (text/csv)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Acme Billing <acme.billing@acme.io>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discrepancy: missing hourly samples impacting Sept payouts (Acme Co)

Maya — thanks for the clear note and the attached excerpt. I pulled the initial ingest logs and see that our GCP webhook consumer recorded a late-replay for project acme-prod on 2026-09-04 at 04:12 UTC; however a TTL threshold in the sampler dedupe routine incorrectly discarded the replayed hours as "stale" before enrichment. That matches the missing windows you highlighted.

Immediate steps we are taking:
- I'm attaching the raw GCP hourly payloads we still have (gcp_usage_sample_q3-2026.csv) and a provenance checksum bundle.
- I've looped in Marissa (payments) and Karthik (ingest/runtime) to scope the correction and confirm whether we can include the missing hours in the Sep payout or need a retro credit.
- We will also capture the full replay trace for audit.

Can you confirm whether Acme prefers (A) a corrected Sep invoice + immediate credit memo, or (B) a separate retro payout once GCP accepts the amended usage? Either way we'll aim to include VAT evidence for your tax team.

I'll follow up within 24 hours with a proposed remediation plan and ETA. Apologies for the disruption — we want to make this right.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Head of Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0123
---
Attachments: gcp_usage_sample_q3-2026.csv (partial extract), provenance-checksum-log.txt
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Discrepancy: missing hourly samples impacting Sept payouts (Acme Co)

Team — forwarding Acme's report. TL;DR: ingest replay for acme-prod occurred but sampler TTL dedupe marked the replayed hourly blobs as stale; those hours never made it to the enrichment pipeline and therefore never into the invoice. Consequence: usage delta -> VAT misclassification -> withholding.

Proposed plan (please critique):
1) Ingest replay re-run: Karthik to run the replay consumer in replay-mode with TTL disabled for acme-prod. Verify enrichment and produce a reconciliation CSV. (ETA 24h)
2) Post-process VAT mapping: Marissa to validate VAT tags on the reconciled rows and confirm whether the corrected ledger will change withholding flags. (ETA 48h after step 1)
3) Payout path: If step 2 shows corrected ledger resolves withholding, issue a credit memo for the shortfall and request an expedited payout from marketplace ops. If marketplace rules require a retro invoice, we'll prepare and submit with accompanying provenance checksums/traces.
4) Audit / RCA: Capture full consumer trace and checksum bundle for Acme and for internal postmortem.

Questions:
- Karthik, do we have an automated safe-mode to re-ingest replays without the TTL pruning? If not, what's the manual runbook?
- Marissa, will finance accept a credit memo or should we expect to generate a corrected invoice for GCP? I recall some regions require invoice-level adjustments rather than credit memos. Region: US, but Acme has EU legal entity for VAT.

Please reply-all with firm ETAs — I'm going to coordinate with Acme.

Thanks,
Jonas

Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discrepancy: missing hourly samples impacting Sept payouts (Acme Co)

Jonas / Marissa — thanks for the fast triage. We completed the replay acceptance check: the re-ingested hourly blobs for acme-prod (2026-09-04 02:00-05:00 UTC) are now present and associated with order ORD-8943. Because the acceptance window closed for the original Sept payout cycle, GCP cannot retroactively alter the paid invoice; the recommended path per marketplace policy is a seller-issued credit memo with VAT evidence attached.

Action items for Redwood:
- Submit a credit memo (credit amount: USD 14,620) referencing ORD-8943 and include the provenance checksum bundle.
- Attach VAT reallocation evidence (we accept CSV + trace link).
- Provide a short statement confirming the root cause and the steps taken to prevent recurrence (one paragraph).

We marked the order with a metadata tag: redwood-replay-accepted. ETA for payout of the credit once seller provides documents: 10-14 business days.

Regards,
GCP Marketplace Ops
---
